Question ID: USH_U02_L07_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: SS.912.A.3.12, SS.912.A.3.13

Stimulus: Progressive reform matrix and Florida evidence card

Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task
Progressive reform grew from industrial and urban problems such as unsafe work, child labor, political corruption, monopoly power, poverty, unsafe food, and unequal access to power.Progressives identified specific problems in cities, workplaces, business, government, and public health before proposing reforms.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.3.12, SS.912.A.3.13.

Question: Which conclusion is best supported by the evidence detail? (Progressive Reform and Florida Connections)

answer.text: Progressives identified specific problems in cities, workplaces, business, government, and public health before proposing reforms.
